sections.heading: Kérdőszavak – Basic Question Words
paragraphs: Hungarian uses the form QW + verb to form questions with questions words.
list: Hol van a könyv? – Where is the book?

sections.heading: Yes/No Questions
paragraphs: Yes/no questions use the same word order as statements. Rising intonation at the end of the sentence signals that it is a question.
list: Jössz ma? – Are you coming today?
